integrity: Proof gives all infinite quantifiers. Finite calculations are supplementary. Earlier exact recurrence and count lemma are explicitly attributed to their source.
scientific_limitations: Requires the eventual recurrence of the greedy sequence; established for c=1,k>=11 and every fixed c at sufficiently large k.
The sharp exponential growth base is proved, not a limiting multiplicative constant.
title: Strict representation entropy for almost-consecutive forbidden-index decompositions
